purpose: 处理上一轮三例joint_route_blocked归位拒绝，验证保持夹爪实际开口的小幅退离能否接上已验证的7关节归位

history_review.reason: 旧的两个酒瓶结束状态真实关节归位成功，复用控制器/阈值/严格保护；不是本轮三例终态
12例中case02/07/08第一技能成功但归位scratch预检拒绝且0归位动作，复用终态、原动作和来源；没有保持实际夹爪开口先退离的测试结果，故只补这3例

hypothesis: 保持终态夹爪实际开口，小幅沿接触外法线或上方退离，可在不改变第一任务成果的情况下脱离架子/灶台，再通过原严格归位
information_gain: 只验证拒绝归位这一故障；相同历史终态由原动作真实重放且origin/finalSHA精确相等才进入退离。不能证明后续VLA改进，不能单独分辨保持开口与退离各自贡献

changed_factors.name: pre_home_safe_exit
changed_factors.reason: 真实终态已有轻微robot接触；原scratch立即恢复finger_home会扩大部分接触，新增有界退离而非忽略碰撞

fixed_factors.environment: native LIBERO goal task8 / robosuite MuJoCo / MountedPanda
fixed_factors.action_sources: frozen original sent_action float32 real replay; no new model inference
fixed_factors.joint_home: unchanged joint_home.py and original run_home, kp50/damping1; q .01rad/speed .02rad/s/finger .002m/5post; cap360
fixed_factors.object_protection: all jointed objects; free5mm/rotation .05rad/hinge .05rad/slide5mm; empty hand; prior literal native goal preserved; stove state unchanged
fixed_factors.policy_rng: not_applicable_no_new_VLA; historical original action prefix reused

success_criteria: 每例重放origin和terminalSHA均与原记录精确相同；退离<=80且最终空接触连续5个真实post-action samples（already_clear0步需单列，不能编造确认）；原归位<=360且home.ready/restore.ok、完整保护和原已完成literalgoal持续成立/连续5post归位就绪。成功只计该例恢复归位，不计完整组合任务
failure_criteria: 已知物理失败：无合法候选、contact加深/新pair/重接触、物体/原成果破坏、退离或归位动作预算耗尽；立即停该例辅助，剩余固定例照计划，无调参和重试
unknown_criteria: 输入/原字节/原stateSHA不匹配、观察不完整、read/emit/step/controllerrestore异常；标unknown并停整个campaign，剩余not_run；不可写成功或补采样

scope.stop_rule: one per fixed case; replay334+retreat<=240+home<=1080; no new VLA/Hermes; no retries/tuning/downstream; known physical fail stop case, infrastructure unknown stop campaign

configuration.gripper_hold: actual qpos normalized by corresponding position-actuator ctrlrange; zero gripper action holds command
configuration.source_freeze: all current top-level Python SHA map locked in accepted software proof before launch

repeat.reason: 新保持开口退离干预；原三例没有该机制，原初始/终态SHA将在重放时再核对
